items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “I know who you are, boy. Do you ever sleep at home now?”

ctx.x: After high school, what was your plan?

I’m not sure I had a plan. When I was in high school, I worked at night. I worked as a bus boy at a place called LaRue’s and another place called The Plantation and several of the clubs. So I worked – when I would get out of school, I would go straight there at 4 o’clock. I would work from 4 to midnight, and then I would take my tuba or trombone, and I would go sit in until 3 in the morning and then get up at 7 o’clock and start school again.
